name: Lézard
source:
A Frenchman that has the uncanny ability to get anywhere. His specialties are wall-climbing and death-defying feats of parkour. He will best his opponents by arriving from unexpected directions and by disappearing down paths none thought traversable.
The love/hate-relationship between him and Sensei causes his emotions to be in constant turmoil as he fluctuates between respecting and loathing his rival.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31464]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
